name: Microsoft Video Description (MSVD) Dataset
description: A collection of short YouTube video clips paired with multiple crowd-sourced English descriptions, used for video captioning and video-language research. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Chen, D. L., & Dolan, W. B. (2011). Collecting highly parallel data for paraphrase evaluation. Proceedings of the 49th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies, 190–200. https://aclanthology.org/P11-1020/

license.identifier: Not specified (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: The upstream dataset does not specify a standard SPDX license identifier. Videos are sourced from YouTube and may be subject to the rights and terms applicable to each video; review upstream terms and source-media restrictions before use or redistribution.
